title: Pregnant at 17
overview: After witnessing a brutal crime, things are finally starting to look up for 17 year old high school dropout Chelsea.  She's fallen madly in love with Jeff, an older and accomplished man who is promising to give her the life she can only dream of; there's only one hitch...he's still married!  To make matters worse, Chelsea finds out she is pregnant and Jeff wants nothing to do with the baby.

file.itemTitle: What To Do If You Get Her Pregnant - Offbeat Ep 17
